decision: set done = every public URL serves the same status, redirect, title, meta, canonical, JSON-LD, headings, text and links as production, plus a working /api/ask
why: the site is content and SEO; visible parity is what visitors and crawlers see

decision: sized it at ~65 source files, 7 routes, 4 server concerns (ask API, OG images, heatmap refresh, sitemap/robots)
why: need the size before picking rigor
result: medium-high rigor: reversible via Vercel rollback, but SEO and redirects are hard to undo once crawled

decision: built a parity snapshot/diff script and captured production as the baseline
why: compare old vs new on the real served output instead of reading code

decision: re-ran the snapshot and diffed it against the first
why: a self-diff passes trivially, so check the harness has no noise first

decision: found Vercel previews are behind Vercel Authentication and the CLI is logged out
why: deploy-level checks (ISR, BotID, firewall) need a reachable preview

decision: switched the baseline from production to a local next build of the same commit
why: production can run a different commit than the branch, which would show content drift as migration diffs

decision: masked the live heatmap total and ignored redirect content types and the two .ico MIME spellings
why: they differed between two Next snapshots, so they are noise, not migration signal
evidence: scripts/parity.ts; prod vs local diff went from 8 differences to 0
result: harness fixed in its own change

decision: dry-run the whole port in a separate worktree instead of writing the playbook from docs
why: the docs left 6 items UNCONFIRMED (nitro config placement, ISR, 404 status, BotID in Nitro, analytics, streaming); only a build answers them

decision: mark server modules with @tanstack/react-start/server-only instead of renaming to .server.ts
why: same build-time protection, smaller diff

decision: read case study MDX for /api/ask with import.meta.glob ?raw instead of readFileSync
why: drops the runtime file read and the outputFileTracingIncludes config

decision: serve content screenshots through vite-imagetools as WebP at 1408px with width and height
why: plain imports would ship the 834 KB mockup.png and lose the size attributes next/image set

decision: wrapped the MDX plugin to skip ?raw imports
why: '@mdx-js/rollup strips the query before matching, so it compiled the raw MDX into components and the build crashed
evidence: vite.config.ts mdx wrapper; first build: source.replace is not a function

decision: replaced @vercel/og with satori + @resvg/resvg-js
why: '@vercel/og 1.0.3 does a dynamic require of fs that crashes in Nitro's ESM server bundle
evidence: build error: Dynamic require of fs is not supported

decision: dropped TanStack prerender and used Nitro ISR route rules: /** until next deploy, / every 86400 s
why: the crawler wrote / as static index.html through the /#work link, which would freeze the heatmap; ISR is the same Vercel mechanism Next uses for revalidate
result: VERIFIED in build output, INCONCLUSIVE on Vercel

decision: fixed Nitro redirects to use status: 308
why: statusCode was ignored without a type error and produced 307s

decision: set maxDuration 30 for all functions instead of a functionRule for /api/ask
why: Nitro emits functionRules routes after the ISR catch-all, so /api/ask would never reach its own function

decision: proxied BotID challenge paths with Nitro routeRules copied from the botid Nuxt module and passed request headers to checkBotId
why: withBotId is Next-only; Nuxt runs on Nitro so its rules are the closest known-good config
result: INCONCLUSIVE until a Vercel preview is reachable

decision: added <meta name=robots content=noindex> inside NotFound
why: parity diff showed Next emits it on 404 and route head() does not run for unmatched paths

decision: kept the site OG image on /cv as an intended difference
why: TanStack merges parent head tags, so /cv inherits the root og:image; a share card on /cv is an improvement
evidence: parity diff: 10 og/twitter image tags on /cv

decision: parity diff local Next vs local Start
why: the predicate
result: VERIFIED: 0 differences except the accepted /cv image tags

decision: browser smoke on both builds
why: parity reads HTML only; hydration, client nav, palette and fonts need a browser
result: VERIFIED: 10/10 pass on Next and Start

decision: pixel diff at 1280 and 390 on 5 pages
why: catch CSS, font and layout changes the HTML diff cannot see
result: 9/10 identical; treddy-se differs only in image encoding and a 0.17 px offset from Next srcset rounding

decision: measured gzipped HTML+JS per page
why: risk was that losing RSC ships all MDX to the client
evidence: scratchpad gz.ts: / 275 KB -> 208 KB, /work/treddy-se 195 KB -> 158 KB

decision: probed streaming with a throwaway route through createTextStreamResponse
why: no API key available to stream a real answer
evidence: ttfb 0.12 s, total 2.2 s for 3 chunks 700 ms apart
result: VERIFIED on node-server, real /api/ask answer INCONCLUSIVE

decision: typecheck, lint (typescript-eslint, react-hooks, tanstack router) and node --test
why: repo gates
evidence: pnpm typecheck / lint / test in spike

decision: committed the spike and pushed it to get a Vercel preview build
why: the build status on the commit is readable without Vercel auth

decision: first Vercel preview build failed; added vercel.json framework tanstack-start
why: Vercel's tanstack-start detector requires @tanstack/router-plugin in package.json, which the spike did not list
evidence: '@vercel/frameworks tanstack-start detectors; status on b5b46f7 failure

decision: checked NITRO_PRESET=vercel builds the Vercel output locally
why: the playbook's static Vercel-output gate needs a local command

decision: tried to snapshot the Vercel preview
why: the predicate is defined on a preview
evidence: preview URL returns 302 to Vercel SSO
result: INCONCLUSIVE: needs a Protection Bypass for Automation secret

decision: wrote the playbook as a stacked plan: harness PR, toolchain+port PR, cleanup PR
why: the framework swap cannot build halfway, so phases 1 and 2 ship together as two commits
